_purpose: Per-rule expected derived_status when audit-collect.ts runs against examples/golden-audit/synthetic-repo/ in --working-tree --no-network mode. The orchestrator at tools/tests/check-golden-audit.ts asserts equality. A mismatch on any listed rule means the collector's behavior drifted relative to the curated synthetic input — investigate before merging.

_notes.null: Means the collector left the row as judgment-required (e.g. hosted-setting rules in --no-network mode). The expected outcome is not Fulfilled but also not Alarm.
_notes.tolerance: Rules NOT listed here are not asserted, so the harness can grow incrementally. To lock down a rule, add it with the expected status.
